subject: Client routing playbook — region cloud evacuation and endpoint reassignment
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: sam.green@tiltcommerce.com, ops@tiltcommerce.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Client routing playbook — region cloud evacuation and endpoint reassignment

Sam / Tilt ops team —

Quick heads up: our cloud provider has reported a partial control-plane outage affecting EU-NORTH-1 and APAC-SOUTH-1 regions. Impact is limited to a subset of regional load-balancers; single-tenant Dedicated pools in those zones may see elevated error rates and routing timeouts. We are NOT seeing degradation in US regions.

We’ve prepared a short forced-reroute playbook for impacted customers so they can redirect traffic while we stabilize regional control planes. Please do the following items in order: 

1) Change API endpoint affinity to global fallback: set api.redwood.ai.region_preference -> "us-west" (TTL-aware change).
2) Update DNS TTL to 60s during the window (we recommend a 5–10 minute maintenance window for the swap).
3) If you use an IP allowlist, add the us-west egress ranges in the attached endpoint-mapping-v2.csv.
4) If you have sidecar or proxy routing rules, run the attached routing-fallback-commands.sh (dry-run first).

We’ll keep you posted on timeline. Our infra team expects partial restoration within 3–6 hours but will confirm. If you want Redwood to coordinate the change, reply with a 30-minute window and an Ops contact phone number; we can perform a scripted switch on your behalf.

Attachments: endpoint-mapping-v2.csv, routing-fallback-commands.sh

Thanks —
Soojín Lee (on-call)
Account Lead, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear steps. A couple quick questions before we proceed: 

- Can you confirm whether sessions using your KV-prefix caches will be invalidated by switching region_preference to us-west? We need to understand if user sessions will require rehydration.
- We prefer Redwood to perform the switch (we have edge config locked down). If you can run the scripted switch, we can give you a 20-minute window starting 10:30 PT. Please confirm and also confirm whether there will be a short client-facing maintenance banner we should show.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: sam.green@tiltcommerce.com, ops@tiltcommerce.com
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Client routing playbook — region cloud evacuation and endpoint reassignment

Hi Sam — quick technical clarifications so you can decide: 

- KV-prefix cache: region affinity swap will preserve on-host KV entries where the sidecar remains; however, any region-scoped in-memory caches tied to EU or APAC nodes will miss until the client hits us-west. We recommend setting a 30s cache-ttl and enabling soft-reload on your proxy to avoid session errors.
- Session tokens: tokens issued by our global auth service remain valid; no re-auth required.
- We can run the scripted switch at 10:30 PT in the window you requested. We will: 
  * Update api.redwood.ai.region_preference to us-west
  * Push new DNS TTL=60 to edge config
  * Execute routing-fallback-commands.sh (dry-run followed by cut)

Planned rollback: if errors spike >2% sustained for 3 minutes we will rollback to client default and notify. 

I’ve attached the routing-fallback-commands.sh we will run and a CSV mapping for IP ranges (endpoint-mapping-v2.csv). Please reply with a single approver name and mobile number (text preferred) to proceed.

-- Rishi
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, sam.green@tiltcommerce.com, ops@tiltcommerce.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 15:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Client routing playbook — region cloud evacuation and endpoint reassignment

Thanks team — tilt has approved the 10:30 PT window; Sam will be the approver and reachable at +1 206-555-0199. Rishi, please proceed with the dry-run at 10:22 and the final switch at 10:30. Soojin, please post the brief client-facing note below when the switch is in progress: 

"We are performing a short infrastructure reroute to a global fallback region (US West) to mitigate a regional cloud control-plane degradation. You may see brief elevated error rates for up to 2 minutes while traffic redirects. No customer action is required."

Action items after cut:
- Rishi: attach cut logs to JIRA INF-4723 and upload the execution trace to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodIncidentPlan
- Soojin: send system-level notice to Tilt support with a follow-up timeline and confirm if they want us to open a status page entry.
- Karthik: coordinate billing SLA exception if Tilt requests a credit; put a hold on unilateral concessions until leadership OK.

We will run a 72-hour postmortem and invite Tilt to a review. I’ve attached a postmortem-template.docx we will use.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com
